# MMDC (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 8 measured or mapped, 8 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 20 not measured

## Measurements

MMDC.Watt | active-power | unit W | mmdc.watt
MMDC.Amp | current | unit A | mmdc.amp
MMDC.Vol | voltage | reference pole-pole | unit V | mmdc.vol
MMDC.VolPsGnd | voltage | reference positive-ground | unit V | mmdc.volpsgnd
MMDC.VolNgGnd | voltage | reference negative-ground | unit V | mmdc.volnggnd
MMDC.Ris | resistance | unit ohm | mmdc.ris
MMDC.RisPsGnd | resistance | reference positive-ground | unit ohm | mmdc.rispsgnd
MMDC.RisNgGnd | resistance | reference negative-ground | unit ohm | mmdc.risnggnd

## Data objects

Watt MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.watt
Amp MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.amp
Vol MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.vol
VolPsGnd MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.volpsgnd
VolNgGnd MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.volnggnd
Ris MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.ris
RisPsGnd MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.rispsgnd
RisNgGnd MV (MMDC): mapped mmdc.risnggnd
